relationships.subject: Farnesyl pyrophosphate
relationships.evidence_quote: FPP is a specific TRPV3 activator with an EC50 value of 0.13 µM

relationships.subject: Nitric oxide
relationships.evidence_quote: NO, a pleiotropic cellular signaling molecule that controls a variety of biological processes, can activate TRPV3 through cysteine nitrosation

relationships.subject: 2-APB
relationships.evidence_quote: The first known synthetic small-molecule activator of TRPV3 is 2-Aminoethoxydiphenyl borate (2-APB)

key_findings: Review of TRPV3 structure, roles in skin physiology, Olmsted syndrome, pain, itch, cancer and cardiac hypertrophy, and its natural and synthetic modulators.
No TRPV3 modulators are on the market; selective high-affinity modulators are lacking.
